mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CO_IDV_PURPOSE () VALUES (#{purposeCd}, #{purposeNm}, #{consentBizCd}, #{smsYn}, #{moYn}, #{minAge}, #{foreignerYn}, #{watchCheckYn}, #{codeValidSec}, #{maxTry}, #{resultValidMin}, #{useYn}, #{updAt}, #{updBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE PURPOSE_NM = VALUES(PURPOSE_NM), CONSENT_BIZ_CD = VALUES(CONSENT_BIZ_CD), SMS_YN = VALUES(SMS_YN), MO_YN = VALUES(MO_YN), MIN_AGE = VALUES(MIN_AGE), FOREIGNER_YN = VALUES(FOREIGNER_YN), WATCH_CHECK_YN = VALUES(WATCH_CHECK_YN), CODE_VALID_SEC = VALUES(CODE_VALID_SEC), MAX_TRY = VALUES(MAX_TRY), RESULT_VALID_MIN = VALUES(RESULT_VALID_MIN), USE_YN = VALUES(USE_YN), UPD_AT = VALUES(UPD_AT), UPD_BY = VALUES(UPD_BY)

INSERT INTO TB_CO_IDV_REQ (REQ_NO, PURPOSE_CD, METHOD, CHANNEL, AGREE_NO, CUST_ID, SESS_KEY, CUST_NM, BIRTH_DT, PHONE_MASK, PROVIDER_TX, MO_CODE, TRY_CNT, EXPIRE_AT, STATUS, CLIENT_IP, REQ_AT) VALUES (#{reqNo}, #{purposeCd}, #{method}, #{channel}, #{agreeNo}, #{custId}, #{sessKey}, #{custNm}, #{birthDt}, #{phoneMask}, #{providerTx}, #{moCode}, 0, #{expireAt}, 'REQUESTED', #{clientIp}, #{reqAt})
mapper.select: SELECT , p.PURPOSE_NM FROM TB_CO_IDV_REQ r LEFT JOIN TB_CO_IDV_PURPOSE p ON p.PURPOSE_CD = r.PURPOSE_CD WHERE r.REQ_NO = #{reqNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CO_IDV_REQ SET TRY_CNT = TRY_CNT + 1 WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo} AND STATUS = 'REQUESTED'

UPDATE TB_CO_IDV_REQ SET STATUS = #{status}, RESULT_CD = #{resultCd}, CI_VAL = #{ciVal}, DI_VAL = #{diVal}, CELL_NO = #{cellNo}, GENDER = #{gender}, NATIONAL_CD = #{nationalCd}, AGE = #{age}, DONE_AT = #{doneAt} WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo} AND STATUS = 'REQUESTED'
